memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports mild fatigue after walking 500 m, otherwise independent in ADLs.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 4/5 (normal).
falls: 0 falls in last 12 m, gait normal, TUG 10 s (normal).
medicines: 4 regular.
mood: reports occasional low mood, denies hopelessness.
carers: daughter, Priya (primary carer).
goals: "I want to stay energetic enough to teach my grandchildren."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD
montelukast 10 mg HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 10.2 g/dL (12‑16)
Serum ferritin 12 ng/mL (15‑150)
MCV 78 fL (80‑100)
Total serum IgE 85 IU/mL (<100)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Skin prick test: positive to house‑dust mite (3 mm wheal) and grass pollen (2 mm).

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: fatigue improved, walks 1 km without rest.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not repeated (annual due).
falls: 0 falls, gait steady, TUG 9 s.
medicines: 4 regular.
mood: mood stable, denies depression.
carers: daughter, Priya.
goals: "I feel able to manage daily chores and enjoy family time."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
ferrous sulfate 200 mg on alternate days
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fluticasone nasal spray 1 spray each nostril OD
montelukast 10 mg HS

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Via clinic app: ‘I’ve noticed less tiredness and my nose is less blocked most days. Thank you.’

memories.author: lab
memories.text:
Haemoglobin 12.4 g/dL (12‑16)
Serum ferritin 48 ng/mL (15‑150)
MCV 86 fL (80‑100)
Total serum IgE 78 IU/mL (<100)

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to Dr S. Rao, Gastroenterology, for evaluation of persistent microcytosis despite iron therapy. Please assess for possible thalassaemia trait and arrange Hb electrophoresis.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Letter from Dr S. Rao: Hb electrophoresis normal, ferritin responsive to iron, no thalassaemia. Advise continue iron supplementation and re‑check in 3 months.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: reports good energy, walks 2 km daily.
cognition: Mini‑Cog 3/5 (still below cutoff? actually 3 >2, so negative).
falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 8 s.
medicines: 4 regular.
mood: mood good, enjoys gardening.
carers: daughter, Priya.
goals: "I want to keep active and travel with my family."

memories.text: Booking: Follow‑up visit with Dr Nandini Kulkarni scheduled for 2026-09-01 at 10:30 am.

memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: remains independent, walks 2 km without fatigue.
cognition: Mini‑Cog not due until next year.
falls: 0 falls, gait steady, TUG 9 s.
medicines: 4 regular.
mood: mood stable, reports happiness.
carers: daughter, Priya.
goals: "I feel well and look forward to volunteering at the local school."
